facts.value: The latch selects gm_SetGameSpeed(5.0f) or gm_ResetGameSpeed(). The setter programs ticks for 1/60/speed; reset uses the configured match game_speed, which need not be 1.0. It does not restore a saved pre-toggle speed. Setup only clears b0 and does not update timing. The unsigned pending flag coalesces all requests. Initialization clears it and resets the signed sequence to zero, potentially discarding a request and reusing filenames. A normal service attempt increments the sequence before formatting and writing, ignores write status and clears pending even after failure. Monotonic numbering is bounded by resets, signed overflow and pathname capacity; no retry or queue exists.
facts.rationale: Correct source layout, state ordering, return behavior or externally verified dependency limits.

facts.value: No request means no work. The flush helper returns immediately for fewer than two XFBs; otherwise it waits while WAITDONE, DRAWDONE or NEXT statuses exist. Selection searches WAITDONE, DRAWDONE, NEXT, then DISPLAY under interrupt protection. A -1 index reports cant find xfb and invokes __assert/HSD_Panic/OSPanic. Normal processing increments the signed sequence before sprintf, attempts one write, discards its return and clears pending. The 32-byte filename buffer holds at most8 formatted number characters because fixed text takes23 plus NUL. Starting at100000000, a nonnegative sequence overflows it; %02d is minimum width. No allocation, clipping, compression or retry occurs.
facts.rationale: Correct source layout, state ordering, return behavior or externally verified dependency limits.
